versions.content: The function EthSwt_GetDuplexMode shall read the cur- rent duplex mode of the indexed switch port. If the indexed Ethernet port reference an Ethernet transceiver, the duplex mode shall be obtained by calling the function EthTrcv_ GetDuplexMode of the Ethernet Transceiver Driver. If the indexed Ether- net Switch port does not reference an Ethernet transceiver, the duplex mode shall be obtained from the MAC interface of the Switch port.
